vehicles.description: The Hennessey Blackbird is a naturally aspirated, manual-transmission touring hypercar inspired by the SR-71 Blackbird aircraft, revealed by Hennessey Special Vehicles on August 3, 2026. As the company’s third hypercar, it prioritizes analog driver engagement over digital complexity, featuring a six-speed gated manual transmission and a screen-free cockpit. Powered by an Ilmor-developed 6.2-liter V8 engine, the Blackbird targets 800–850 horsepower with a redline exceeding 9,000 rpm, enabling a 0–60 mph time of 2.5 seconds and a top speed of 220 mph. The vehicle utilizes a bespoke full-carbon tub and bodywork to achieve a target dry weight of under 3,000 lbs, while active vertical stabilizers deploy at 71 mph for aerodynamic stability. Priced from $2.5 million before taxes, production is strictly limited to 71 examples worldwide, with deliveries expected between 2029 and 2030. The hypercar is designed for long-distance usability, offering adaptive suspension, gullwing doors, and storage for two full-size carry-on bags, distinguishing it from the pure-speed focus of its predecessor, the Venom F5.
